info.description: This collection provides the main Tangerine365 Enterprise API endpoints for authentication, user management, course access, learner progress, and platform configuration. It is intended to help developers and integrators explore and work with the core services that power the Tangerine365 Enterprise experience.

request.description:
## Authenticate

**POST** `https://localhost:8090/api/auth/authenticate`

Authenticates a user against the system. On success, returns an authentication token plus the user's basic details. If two-factor authentication (2FA) is enabled globally and applies to this user, the endpoint also initializes the 2FA challenge — the returned token is flagged as **pending verification** and cannot be used to access protected endpoints until `verify2fa` succeeds.

### Request

- **Method:** POST
    
- **Base URL:** `https://localhost:8090/`
    
- **Path:** `/api/auth/authenticate`
    
- **Headers:**
    - `Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
        

### Request Body

Type: `x-www-form-urlencoded`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `username` | string | Yes | Username of the account to authenticate. |
| `password` | string | Yes | Password of the account to authenticate. |
| `orgid` | string | No | Organization/tenant identifier, used to resolve `username` in multi-tenant setups. |
  

### Responses

**400 — Missing credentials**

``` json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Error: invalid login data provided."
}

 ```

**400 — Invalid credentials**

``` json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Error: invalid credentials"
}

 ```

**400 — Token auth not enabled on this installation**

``` json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Error: Tokens are not used on this installation."
}

 ```

**200 — Success, no 2FA required**

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "You are authenticated.",
  "data": { "...": "user details, see below" },
  "token": "b1946ac92492d2347c6235b4d2611184",
  "expire_at": "2026-08-24 15:30:00"
}

 ```

**200 — Success, 2FA required**

Same as above, plus `requires_2fa: true` and a set of 2FA challenge fields that vary by the method configured for the user. `message` is appended with the 2FA instruction.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `requires_2fa` | boolean | Always `true` in this case. Token is issued but gated until `verify2fa`. |
| `method` | string | `email`, `authenticator`, or `both`. |
| `twofa_expiry_time` | integer | OTP validity window (email method / both). |
| `requires_setup` | boolean | Present for `authenticator` when no secret exists yet — app needs first-time setup. |
| `secret` | string | Authenticator secret (only when setup is required). |
| `qr_code` | string | QR code data for authenticator setup (only when setup is required). |
| `manual_entry_key` | string | Same as `secret`, for manual entry into an authenticator app. |
| `method_selection_required` | boolean | Present when `method` is `both` — client must ask the user to choose before an OTP is generated. |
| `available_methods` | array | `["email", "authenticator"]`, present when `method` is `both`. |
| `authenticator_setup_required` | boolean | Present when `method` is `both`, indicates whether the authenticator still needs setup. |

Example (`method: "both"`, authenticator not yet set up):

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "You are authenticated. Multiple 2FA methods are available. Please choose whether you want to receive a code by email or use your authenticator app.",
  "data": { "...": "user details" },
  "token": "b1946ac92492d2347c6235b4d2611184",
  "expire_at": "2026-08-24 15:30:00",
  "requires_2fa": true,
  "method": "both",
  "method_selection_required": true,
  "available_methods": ["email", "authenticator"],
  "authenticator_setup_required": true,
  "twofa_expiry_time": 300,
  "secret": "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP",
  "qr_code": "data:image/png;base64,...",
  "manual_entry_key": "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP"
}

 ```

### `data` object (user details)

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `idst` | integer | Unique numeric ID of the user. |
| `userid` | string | Username of the authenticated user. |
| `firstname` | string | First name. |
| `lastname` | string | Last name. |
| `avatar` | string | Filename of the user's avatar image. |
| `email` | string | Email address. |
| `signature` | string | User's signature. |
| `valid` | integer | 1 = valid account, 0 = invalid. |
| `pwd_expire_at` | datetime | Password expiry timestamp. |
| `register_date` | datetime | Registration date. |
| `last_enter` | datetime | Last login timestamp. |
| `custom_fields` | array | Custom user fields; empty if none. |

### Top-level response fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `success` | boolean | Whether authentication succeeded. |
| `message` | string | Human-readable result message. |
| `data` | object | User details (see above). |
| `token` | string | Auth token. **If** **`requires_2fa`** **is true, this token is not usable until** **`verify2fa`** **completes.** |
| `expire_at` | datetime | Token expiration timestamp. |
| `requires_2fa` | boolean | Present only when 2FA applies to this login. |

## Get 2FA Config

**POST** `/api/twofa/get2faconfig`

Returns the current global 2FA configuration and whether it applies to the authenticated user, without triggering any challenge.

### Request

- **Method:** POST
    
- **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/api/twofa/get2faconfig`
    
- **Headers:**
    

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `Accept` | `application/json` |

### Body Parameters (URL-encoded)

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `auth` | ✅ Yes | The authenticated user's token. Uses the `{{token}}` environment variable. |

### Responses

**401 — Not authenticated**

``` json
{ "success": false, "message": "User is not authenticated" }

 ```

**200 — Success**

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "enabled": true,
    "required_for_user": true,
    "method": "both",
    "expiry_time": 300
  }
}

 ```

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Whether 2FA is enabled globally. |
| `required_for_user` | boolean | Whether it's enforced for this specific user/level. |
| `method` | string | `email`, `authenticator`, or `both`. |
| `expiry_time` | integer | OTP validity window, in seconds. |

**500 — Unexpected error**

``` json
{ "success": false, "message": "An unexpected error occurred: <details>" }

 ```

## Init 2FA

**POST** `/api/twofa/init2fa`

Initializes the Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) process for an authenticated user. Checks whether 2FA is required for the account, determines the configured verification method, and triggers the appropriate challenge (sends an email OTP, returns authenticator setup info, or asks the user to choose a method).

### Request

- **Method:** POST
    
- **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/api/twofa/init2fa`
    
- **Headers:**
    

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `Accept` | `application/json` |
| `Content-Type` | `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` |

- **Body Parameters (URL-encoded):**
    

| Parameter | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `auth` | `{{token}}` | The authenticated user's token, used to identify and authorize the request. |

### Responses

**401 — Not authenticated**

``` json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "User is not authenticated"
}

 ```

**200 — 2FA not required for this account**

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "requires_2fa": false,
  "message": "2FA is not required for your account"
}

 ```

**200 — Email method**

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "requires_2fa": true,
  "method": "email",
  "message": "OTP has been sent to your email"
}

 ```

**500 — Email send failure**

``` json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Failed to send OTP: <reason>"
}

 ```

**200 — Authenticator method, setup required** _(no secret exists yet)_

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "requires_setup": true,
  "message": "Authenticator app setup required. You can scan the QR code using an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, etc.) or manually enter the setup key provided below.",
  "setup_options": {
    "browser_setup": "Scan this QR code using your authenticator app",
    "mobile_setup": "If you prefer to use the app, manually enter the setup key below",
    "setup_url": "You can also complete the setup on the browser version"
  },
  "secret": "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP",
  "qr_code": "data:image/png;base64,...",
  "manual_entry_key": "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP"
}

 ```

**200 — Authenticator method, already set up**

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "requires_2fa": true,
  "method": "authenticator",
  "message": "Please enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app"
}

 ```

**200 — Both methods enabled**

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "requires_2fa": true,
  "method": "both",
  "method_selection_required": true,
  "available_methods": ["email", "authenticator"],
  "authenticator_setup_required": true,
  "twofa_expiry_time": 300,
  "message": "Multiple 2FA methods are available. Please choose whether you want to receive a code by email or use your authenticator app.",
  "secret": "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP",
  "qr_code": "data:image/png;base64,...",
  "manual_entry_key": "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP"
}

 ```

> `secret` / `qr_code` / `manual_entry_key` only appear here if the authenticator hasn't been set up yet (`authenticator_setup_required: true`). 
  

**400 — Invalid config**

``` json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Invalid 2FA configuration"
}

 ```

**500 — Unexpected error**

``` json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "An unexpected error occurred: <details>"
}

 ```

### Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `success` | boolean | Whether the request was processed successfully. |
| `requires_2fa` | boolean | `true` if 2FA applies to this user; absent/`false` cases return early. |
| `requires_setup` | boolean | Present when the authenticator method needs first-time setup. |
| `method` | string | Configured 2FA method: `email`, `authenticator`, or `both`. |
| `method_selection_required` | boolean | Present when `method` is `both` — client must ask the user to choose before an OTP is generated. |
| `available_methods` | array | e.g. `["email", "authenticator"]` — present when `method` is `both`. |
| `authenticator_setup_required` | boolean | Present when `method` is `both`, indicates whether the authenticator still needs setup. |
| `twofa_expiry_time` | integer | OTP validity window in seconds (email / both). |
| `secret` / `manual_entry_key` | string | Authenticator setup secret (only when setup is required). |
| `qr_code` | string | Base64 QR code image data for authenticator setup (only when setup is required). |
| `setup_options` | object | Human-readable hints for completing authenticator setup. |
| `message` | string | Human-readable description of the result. |

## Resend 2FA

**POST** `/api/twofa/resend2fa`

Generates and sends a new email OTP. Only applicable when the account's 2FA method is `email` or `both`.

### Request

- **Method:** POST
    
- **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/api/twofa/resend2fa`
    
- **Headers:**
    

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `Accept` | `application/json` |
| `Content-Type` | `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` |

### Body Parameters (URL-encoded)

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `auth` | ✅ Yes | The authenticated user's token. Uses the `{{token}}` environment variable. |

### Responses

**401 — Not authenticated**

``` json
{ "success": false, "message": "User is not authenticated" }

 ```

**400 — 2FA not required**

``` json
{ "success": false, "message": "2FA is not required for your account" }

 ```

**400 — Not applicable for authenticator method**

``` json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "OTP resend is not applicable for authenticator method. Please use your authenticator app to generate the verification code."
}

 ```

**200 — Success**

``` json
{ "success": true, "message": "New OTP has been sent to your email" }

 ```

**500 — Failed to resend**

``` json
{ "success": false, "message": "Failed to resend OTP" }

 ```

**500 — Unexpected error**

``` json
{ "success": false, "message": "An unexpected error occurred: <details>" }

 ```

request.description:
## Verify 2FA

**POST** `/api/twofa/verify2fa`

Validates the OTP or authenticator code and, on success, unlocks the user's auth token for use on other protected endpoints.

### Request

- **Method:** POST
- **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/api/twofa/verify2fa`
- **Headers:**

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| `Accept` | `application/json` |
| `Content-Type` | `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` |

### Body Parameters (URL-encoded)

| Parameter | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `auth` | ✅ Yes | The authenticated user's token. Uses the `{{token}}` environment variable. |
| `method` | ✅ Yes | `email` or `authenticator`. |
| `code` | ✅ Yes | The OTP (email) or 6-digit TOTP code (authenticator). |

### Responses

**401 — Not authenticated**
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "User is not authenticated" }
```

**400 — 2FA not required**
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "2FA is not required for your account" }
```

**400 — Missing parameters**
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "Missing required parameters: method and code" }
```

**400 — Invalid method**
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "Invalid method. Must be either \"email\" or \"authenticator\"" }
```

**400 — Authenticator required but not yet configured**

(returned when `method` is `authenticator`, or `method` is `email` but the account's configured method is `authenticator`/`both`, and no secret exists yet)
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "requires_setup": true,
  "message": "Authenticator app is not yet configured. Please set it up to use this method.",
  "setup_options": {
    "browser_setup": "Visit the browser version to scan the QR code and set up your authenticator",
    "mobile_setup": "Use the setup key below to manually configure your authenticator app"
  },
  "secret": "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP",
  "manual_entry_key": "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP",
  "qr_code": "data:image/png;base64,..."
}
```

**200 — Success**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "2FA verification successful" }
```

**400 — Invalid or expired code**
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "Invalid or expired code" }
```
*(or `"Invalid authenticator code"` for the authenticator path)*

**500 — Unexpected error**
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "An unexpected error occurred: <details>" }
```

## Verify 2FA Setup

**POST** `/api/twofa/verify2fasetup`

Confirms first-time authenticator app setup by validating the first generated code against the newly created secret. On success, this also unlocks the auth token (counts as verification).

### Request

- **Method:** POST
    
- **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/api/twofa/verify2fasetup`
    
- **Headers:**
    

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `Accept` | `application/json` |
| `Content-Type` | `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` |

### Body Parameters (URL-encoded)

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `auth` | ✅ Yes | The authenticated user's token. Uses the `{{token}}` environment variable. |
| `code` | ✅ Yes | 6-digit code generated by the authenticator app using `secret`. |
| `secret` | ✅ Yes | The setup secret returned by `init2fa` (or `verify2fa`'s setup-required response). |

### Responses

**401 — Not authenticated**

``` json
{ "success": false, "message": "User is not authenticated" }

 ```

**400 — 2FA not required**

``` json
{ "success": false, "message": "2FA is not required for your account" }

 ```

**400 — Missing parameters**

``` json
{ "success": false, "message": "Missing required parameters: code and secret" }

 ```

**200 — Success**

``` json
{ "success": true, "message": "Authenticator setup verified successfully" }

 ```

**400 — Invalid code**

``` json
{ "success": false, "message": "Invalid code for authenticator setup" }

 ```

**500 — Unexpected error**

``` json
{ "success": false, "message": "An unexpected error occurred: <details>" }

 ```

(0 = Only Admin, 1 = Requires admin approval, 2 = Free for all), - unsubscribe_method (string) The method for unsubscribing from the course. request.description:
The `POST /api/user/userdetailsbyuserid` endpoint is used to retrieve user assigned courses based on the user ID.

### Request

- Method: POST
    
- Base URL: {{baseUrl}}
    
- Path: /api/user/userCourses
    
- Headers:
    
    - Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
        
- Body:
    
    - `idst` (text): The user ID for which details are to be retrieved.
        
    - `auth` (text): The authentication token for the request.
        

### Response

- The response will be in JSON format with the following structure:
    
    - `success` (boolean): Indicates the success of the request.
        
    - `courses` (array): An array of user courses.
        
        - `course_info` (object): Information about the course.
            
            - `code` (string): The code of the course.
                
            - `course_id` (string): The ID of the course.
                
            - `course_type` (string): The type of the course.
                
            - `course_name` (string): The name of the course.
                
            - `course_image` (string): The image of the course.
                
            - `course_description` (string): The description of the course.
                
            - `course_link` (string): The link to the course.
                
            - `user_status` (string): The status of the user in the course.
                
            - `waiting` (string): The waiting status.
                
            - `enrolled` (number): The number of users enrolled in the course.
                
            - `date_end` (string): The end date of the course.
                
            - `can_enter` (object): Information about user's access to the course.
                
                - `can` (boolean): Indicates if the user can enter the course.
                    
                - `reason` (string): The reason for access denial.
                    
                - `expiring_in` (boolean): Indicates if the access is expiring soon.
                    
            - `date_subscribed` (string): The date of subscription to the course.
                
            - `date_first_access` (string): The date of the first access to the course.
                
            - `course_stats` (object): Statistics about the course.
                
                - `status` (string): The status of the course.
                    
                - `date_first_access` (string): The date of the first access to the course.
                    
                - `date_complete` (string): The date of course completion.
                    
            - `dates` (array): An array of dates related to the course.

The `POST /api/user/getlo`endpoint is used to retrieve learning objects for a course based on the course ID.

### Request

- Method: POST
    
- Base URL: {{baseUrl}}
    
- Path: /api/user/userStats
    
- Headers:
    
    - Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
        
- Body:
    
    - `idst` (text): User ID
        
    - `course_id` (text): The course ID for which details are to be retrieved.
        
    - `auth` (string): Authorization token
        

### Response

- `success` (boolean): Indicates the success of the request.
    
- `lo_course` (array): an array of learning objects associated with the course. Each item structure is:
    
    - `name_lo`: Name of learning object
        
    - `name_course:` Course name associated with the learning object.
        
    - `id_item:` unique identifier for the learning object
        
    - `id_course`: the course ID
        
    - `visible:` status to determine if the learning object is visible.
        
    - `type:` type of learning object.
        
    - `src`: if applcable, points to the storage location for the learning object.
        
    - `lo_status:` learning object status

request.description:
The API endpoint `{{baseUrl}}/api/course/course`is a POST request that is used to retrieve a course based on the courseID

### Request

- Method: POST
    
- Base URL: {{baseUrl}}
    
- Path: /api/course/course
    
- Headers:
    
    - Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
        

### Request Body

The request body type is **`x-www-form-urlencoded`**

- `idst` (string) - optional: User ID
    
- `auth` (string): Authentication token is required
    
- `course_id` (string): Course ID
    

### Response

The response will be in JSON format and will include the following fields:

- `success` (boolean): Indicates the success status of the request.
    
- `course` (object): Represents a course with various properties.
    
    - `idCourse` (string): The unique identifier for the course.
        
    - `idCategory` (string): The category ID the course belongs to.
        
    - `code` (string): The code associated with the course.
        
    - `name` (string): The name of the course.
        
    - `description` (string): The description of the course.
        
    - `box_description` (string): The box description of the course.
        
    - `lang_code` (string): The language code for the course.
        
    - `status` (string): The status of the course.
        
    - `course_type` (string): The type of course it is.
        
    - `subscribe_method` (string): The method for subscribing to the course.
        
        - `0` - Only Admin can subscribe users to the course
            
        - `1` - Subscription requires admin approval
            
        - `2` - Subscription is free to all
            
    - `mediumTime` (string)
        
    - `show_rules` (string): Indicates wether to display rules.
        
    - `selling` (string): The selling status of the course.
        
    - `prize` (string): The price of the course.
        
    - `course_demo` (string): The course demo.
        
    - `create_date` (string): The date the course was created.
        
    - `course_edition` (string): The course edition ID.
        
    - `can_subscribe` (string): The subscription availability status.
        
        - `0` - Subscription is closed
            
        - `1` - Subscription is open at all times
            
        - `2` - Subscription is open only when the current date is within the subscription start and end date set on the course (Key: sub_start_date sub_end_date
            
    - `sub_start_date` (string): The start date for subscription.
        
    - `sub_end_date` (string): The end date for subscription.
        
    - `date_begin` (string): The start date of the course.
        
    - `date_end` (string): The end date of the course.
        
    - `img_course` (string): The path/source to the course image

The API endpoint `{{baseUrl}}/api/course/courses` is a POST request that is used to retrieve a list of courses.

### Request

- Method: POST
    
- Base URL: {{baseUrl}}
    
- Path: /api/course/categories
    
- Headers:
    
    - Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
        

### Request Body

The request body for this endpoint is of type x-www-form-urlencoded.

- `idst` (string): User ID
    
- `auth` (string): Authentication token.
    
- `category` (string): Category ID
    
- `page` (string): Page number to return
    
- `limit` (string): Number of records to return.
    

### Response

Upon a successful execution of the request, the API returns a JSON response with a status code of 200. The `courses` key in the response contains an array of course objects. Each course object consists of the following fields:

- `course_id` (string): The unique identifier for the course.
    
- `code` (string): The code associated with the course.
    
- `course_name` (string): The name of the course.
    
- `course_description` (string): The description of the course.
    
- `course_box_description` (string): The box description of the course.
    
- `status` (string): The status of the course.
    
- `selling` (string): The selling status of the course.
    
- `price` (string): The price of the course.
    
- `subscribe_method` (string): The method for subscribing to the course.
    
    - `0` - Only Admin can subscribe users to the course
        
    - `1` - Subscription requires admin approval
        
    - `2` - Subscription is free to all
        
- `unsubscribe_method` (string): The method for unsubscribing from the course.
    
    - `0` - Only Admin can unsubscribe users to the course
        
    - `1` - Unsubscription requires admin approval
        
    - `2` - Unsubscription is free to all
        
- `course_edition` (string): The edition of the course.
    
- `course_type` (string): The type of the course.
    
- `can_subscribe` (string): The subscription availability status.
    
    - `0` - Subscription is closed
        
    - `1` - Subscription is open at all times
        
    - `2` - Subscription is open only when the current date is within the subscription start and end date set on the course (Key: sub_start_date sub_end_date
        
- `sub_start_date` (string): The start date for subscription.
    
- `sub_end_date` (string): The end date for subscription.
    
- `date_begin` (string): The start date of the course.
    
- `date_end` (string): The end date of the course.
    
- `course_link` (string): The link to the course.
    
- `img_course` (string): The image associated with the course.
    
- `category_id` (string): The unique identifier for the category of the course.
    
- `category` (string): The category of the course.
    
- `enrolled` (string): The enrollment status of the course.
    
- `dates` (array): An array of dates associated with the course.
    

Each field in the `courses` response object represents a specific attribute of the course and is accompanied by its respective data type.

request.description:
The `POST /api/webpages/index` endpoint is used to retrieve webpages from the system.

### Request

- Method: POST
    
- Base URL: {{baseUrl}}
    
- Path: /api/webpages/index
    
- Headers:
    
    - Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
        

### Request Body

The request body for this endpoint is of type x-www-form-urlencoded.

- `auth` (string): Authentication token.
    

### Response

The response will be in JSON format and will include the following fields:

- `success` (string): Indicates the success status of the request.
    
- `message` (string): Provides additional information about the request.
    
- `data` (array): Contains an array of objects, each representing a webpage.
    
    - `id` (string): The unique identifier for the webpage.
        
    - `title` (string): The title of the webpage.
        
    - `description` (string): The description of the webpage and its content.

Suspends one or more users by user ID or username. Both `useridst` and `usernames` accept comma-separated values. Organization ID is required for tenant users.

### Notes

- You may suspend users by providing either `useridst`, `usernames`, or both, as comma-separated values.
    
- `orgid` is required for tenant users; omit or set to `null` for non-tenant users if your backend allows.
    
- Ensure the `auth` token is valid and has the necessary permissions.
